why: So that CPU-only notebooks can resolve prompt text without touching walledai/AdvBench, which is gated: make_splits downloads BOTH datasets to build any split, so a notebook that needs nothing but the 48 prompt strings was failing on a HuggingFace auth error with no model in sight. Notebook 09 hit exactly that on 30 August.
